chk_scale.note: FLAG: no calipers (scan-only, DECISIONS.md MEASUREMENTS); units assumed mm, scale unverified, none applied

primary.desc: PCB top face (component side, solder mask)
primary.why: the board top is the seating plane of every component and the reference an enclosure / mating part locates the PCB on

xy.desc: mounting hole H1 (the corner hole with a fully scanned wall)
xy.why: mounting holes locate the PCB in the enclosure

origin.definition: mounting hole H1 axis ∩ PCB top face

clock.desc: PCB short edge on the far side from H1 (edge face outward normal) -> +X
clock.why: board outline edges are the second locating reference; the long board axis runs along +X
